description: This file defines the CredentialsResult class, a generic container for responses returned by Hono's credentials API, including methods to create instances with different parameters such as status, payload, cache directives, and application properties.

classes.name: CredentialsResult
classes.description: A final generic class extending RequestResponseResult, representing a response containing credentials information, with static factory methods for creating instances with various response details.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating CredentialsResult instances with different combinations of status, payload, cache directives, and application properties.
